deviations.author: Claude (execution)
deviations.decision: No scientific configuration, split, registry or verifier file is changed. All preregistered units are completed; the preregistered truncation order is NOT applied because the overrun is a runtime-model error, not a scope change, and every truncation item is cheap in measured time (conditional CREMA-D FT seed 1 projected 1.9 h measured). Caps are read on the planning cost model. The author may overrule this and apply the truncation order post hoc by voiding the listed units before scoring; nothing in results.json would otherwise differ.
deviations.execution_note: CTRL was run as six disjoint (corpus_level, model) queues in parallel (tools/run_ctrl_queue.sh; OMP_NUM_THREADS=2) and MECH2X2 queues were started while the CTRL tail finished; unit order within each queue follows the plan sort. Per-process cap accounting therefore saw only its own queue.
deviations.what: Measured GPU-seconds of scratch-model units are ~3x the frozen cost model (SEC_PER_TRAIN_UTT 0.0095 s): CREMA-D CNN fold 139 s vs 42 s planned; the P1 engine's SpecAugment loop is CPU-bound and the GPU idles. The CTRL arm's recorded gpu_seconds passed the 16 h arm cap at ~14:35 local with ~1,600/3,139 units done; the program's measured total will exceed the 50 h program cap although the planned cost (38.15 + 8.0 h) is within it.
